sections.content: Choose the pretérito perfecto when the experience is connected to the present or belongs to a period that is still open: He *aprendido* *mucho* *este* *año*. Choose the indefinido for a completed past period or event: *Aprendí* mucho el año *pasado*. The choice depends on the time frame and meaning.

items.english: I have learned a lot this year.
I learned a lot last year.

sections.content: Check the time frame before choosing the tense. A period connected to the present often uses the pretérito perfecto; a finished past period or completed event often uses the indefinido.
